senses.gloss:
mfn. (-शः-शी-शं)
Silk, silken.
n. (-शं)
Kanyakubja or Kanouj.,the ancient city so called.
E.
कोश, and अण् affix.

mf. (-लं-ली)
1 Greeting, salutation, friendly inquiry.
2 A respectful present, a Nazr.
3 Happiness, welfare, &c.
E.
कुशल good fortune, well-being, अण् and ङीष् affs.

f. (-का)
A present, a respectful gift or offering.
E.
कन् added to the last.

m. (-यः)
A name of RĀMA.
E.
कौशल्या the wife of DAŚARATHA, ढक् affix of descent.

n. (-ल्यं)
1 Good fortune, well-being, &c.
2 Cleverness, talent.
f. (-ल्या)
The mother of RĀMA.
E.
कुशल and यञ् affix, or कोशल a name of the father of this princess, affix ण्यत्.

m. (-नः)
A name of RĀMA.
E.
नन्दन a son, and कौशल्या RĀMA'S mother.

m. (-निः)
RĀMA: see the preceding.
E.
कौशल्या, and फिञ् aff.

n. (-रं)
Silk cloth.
E.
कौश, and अम्बर vesture.

f. (-म्बी)
The name of an ancient city on the Ganges in the lower part of the Doab, in the vicinity of Kurrah; also वत्सपत्तन.
E.
कुशाम्ब a proper name, (the founder,) अण् and ङीप् affs.

(-कः-की-कं)
1 Silk, silken.
2 Of the family of Kuśika, &c.
m. (-कः)
1 A name of INDRA.
2 A fragrant substance, (Bdellium.)
3 An owl.
4 A snake-catcher.
5 An ichneumon, (Viverra ichneumon.)
6 A title of VIŚVAMITRA.
7 One skilled in dictionaries.
8 A dictionary compiler.
9 Love, the passion.
10 The marrow.
f. (-की)
1 A river in Behar, the Kosi or Koosa.
2 A name of the goddess DURGA.
n. (-कं)
Silk.
E.
कोश a sheathe, &c. ठक् affix, and ङीप् for the feminine; also कौषिक, and कौषिकी.

f. (-का)
A drinking vessel, a cup or goblet.
E.
कुश to surround or contain, affixes ण्वुल् and टाप्.

m. (-कः)
A name of INDRA, &c.: see above, काशिक.
f. (-की)
DURGĀ, &c.: see कौशिकी.

m. (-यः)
A name of RĀMA.
E.
कौशिक the sage VIŚVAMITRA, and प्रिय a friend or favourite.

n. (-लं)
A cocoanut.
E.
कौशिक the saint VIŚVAMITRA, and फल fruit, being said to have been created by the sage in his progress to make a human being in rivalry to BRAHMĀ, the nut being the first rudiment of the head.

m. (-जः)
A name of ARJUNA.
E.
कौशिक INDRĀ, and आत्मज a son.

n. (-धं)
The rainbow.
E.
कौशिक INDRĀ, and आयुध a weapon.

m. (-तिः)
A crow.
E.
कौशिक an owl, and अराति an enemy; also कौशिकारि, &c.

f. (-की)
The wife of the saint AGASTYA.
E.
कुश to retract, (wrath,) इतक and ङीष् affixes; this lady being an anti-xantippe.

n. (-व्यं)
The profession of an actor, a dancer, &c.
E.
कुशीलव, and ष्यञ् aff.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Silken, of silk.
n. (-यं)
1 Silk.
2 A silk petticoat or trowsers, a woman's lower garment of silk.
E.
कोश or कोष the cocoon, and ढक affix; also कौषेय.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Silken: see कौशेय.

mfn. (-दः-दी-दं)
Usurious.
E.
कुसीद, and अण् aff.

n. (-द्यं)
1 Sloth, indolence.
2 The practice of usury.
E.
कुसीद usury, &c. affix यञ्.

mfn. (-मः-मी-मं)
Flowering.
E.
कुसुम and अण् aff.

mfn. (-म्भः-म्भी-म्भं)
Dyed with safflower, orange, red.
E.
कुसुम्भ safflower, and अण् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
A juggler, a conjuror.
E.
कुसृति wickedness, affix ठक्.

m. (-भः)
The jewel of KṚṢṆA suspended on his breast.
E.
कुस्तुभ a name of VIṢṆU or KṚṢṆA, and अण् aff.

m. (-कः)
A name of VIṢṆU.

m. (-क्षाः)
A name of VIṢṆU or KṚṢṆA.
E.
कौस्तभ the jewel, and वक्षस् the breast.
